channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by pretix GmbH (pretix).

item.title: CVE-2026-131171 · 5.3 MEDIUM — Room and world premissions not clearly separated
item.description: A bug caused room permissions to leak into the world permissions of the acting user during certain actions.

item.title: CVE-2026-131169 · 2.1 LOW — Permissions are copied when copying scheduled exports
item.description: When a scheduled export is copied, the permissions of the original export's owner are used when running the export. This allows users to create exports with data they usually shouldn't be able to see, but only within events they already have permissi…

item.description: When a ticket holder opens the ticket page of a ticket that is an add-on (possible since 2026.9) the HTML content of the page contains the secret link to the parent product, creating a potential data leak. Under different specific conditions, when a…

item.title: CVE-2026-131168 · 6.6 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Validation bypass allows buying sold-out products
item.description: A legacy code path allowed users to craft requests to a ticket shop that bypass some validation steps for the selected products. In consequence, this could lead to an attacker purchasing products that are in fact sold out.

item.title: CVE-2026-125744 · 1.2 LOW — Missing permission check in ticket layout API
item.description: Our API endpoint for changing ticket layouts did not properly check permissions of the requesting user or API token. An attacker with read-only access to an event could use this to change the event's ticket layout.
